name: bb-plugin-statusbar

bb.name: Statusbar
bb.description: AI usage cost, model lane headroom, and host resources in one bar at the bottom of the window. Additional sections (e.g. Spotify) are contributed by provider plugins.

description: A single status bar at the bottom of the BB window showing AI usage cost, model lane headroom, and host resources. Sections are extensible: provider plugins can claim a topic, including built-in ones.
